name: airgapper
description: Offline file and text transfer using fountain-coded animated QR codes.

scripts.build:apk: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build --mode apk
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build:apk && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build:apk && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleRelease && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk','AirGapper.apk')"
